io.webagent4j.policy.network.INetworkPolicy

Packages that use INetworkPolicy
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.action
Verified browser actions: one explicit, bounded command pipeline per interaction, with three terminal modes - real execution, dryRun(), and plan() - that all share the exact same target-resolution and precondition logic so they can never disagree.
io.webagent4j.policy.network
Network-destination governance: INetworkPolicy decides whether WebAgent4J may make a network request to a given destination, evaluated strictly before the request is sent.

    default IPreparedAction<R>
    IPreparedAction.networkPolicy(INetworkPolicy networkPolicy)
    Configures an INetworkPolicy that must ALLOW this action's network destination - checked before the backend call, and, for a NAVIGATE action, checked again after navigation against the final URL, since a browser's own internal redirects cannot be intercepted mid-flight.
